verdict.rationale: A password manager could plausibly ship in-product AI insights, so the axis applies. The pack shows no AI-generated insights or suggestions inside Bitwarden. Vault health reports (reused/weak passwords) are deterministic local reports, not AI output. The official MCP server lets external AI assistants access the vault, which is a developer building block rather than in-product AI insight.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
